characteristics.$text: Scout, Elite, Behind Enemy Lines, Artillery Spotter, Unique

rules.name: Sniper Hideout
rules.description: A single sniper in reinforced cover. It can be placed anywhere outside of the opponent’s deployment zone. The cover is lost if the sniper moves.

rules.name: Mortar Pit
rules.description: 3 men and an 81mm mortar in reinforced cover. The cover is lost if the mortar team moves.

rules.name: .30 cal MG Dug-out
rules.description: 3 men and a .30 cal MG in reinforced cover. The cover is lost if the MG team moves.

rules.name: Artillery Observation Post
rules.description: A Forward Observer Team in reinforced cover.  The cover is lost if the observer team move.

rules.name: Off-table 76mm Anti-Tank Shot
rules.description: The positions are covered by 76mm anti-tank guns well-camouflaged behind the lines. You may take a single 76mmL53 Aimed Fire – Armour-Piercing shot at an enemy vehicle within 30" of your table edge. The shot will hit on a dice roll of 6, with a penetration value of 4. This requires no orders to use.
